verdict.rationale: Smithery's own shutdown notice says the Smithery API, Connect, Toolbox, accounts and API keys stopped working on October 31, 2026, and that no documented API surface remains. Even the archived docs only described a REST interface for connecting to MCP servers, never API parity with the UI. The surviving CLI only covers registry and tool commands against the public registry, which is not a full API equivalent of the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
